preregistration.owner_directive: Owner-approved M6 three-class Triple-Barrier target redesign; Option A selected; Option B on-chain purchase/data pivot rejected/deferred.
preregistration.scope: Two logical candidates using only the existing Nobitex Spot BTCUSDT PRE-HACK 1h OHLCV artifact: one hourly-decision candidate and one 4h-decision candidate built by deterministic aggregation of four consecutive hourly candles. Both predict 24-hour first-touch event outcomes with exactly three supervised classes. One fixed RandomForestClassifier configuration and one fixed long-entry probability threshold are used; no tuning or alternative model is allowed.
preregistration.change_control: Any change to the market, source artifact/hash, timeframe aggregation, feature names/formulas, ATR method, barrier multiplier, vertical horizon, ambiguous/gap rule, estimator family or parameters, signal threshold, folds, purge/embargo, costs, sizing, economic gates, or trial count requires a new superseding preregistration before outcome inspection. No sweeps, tuning, selective reruns, threshold changes or extra candidates are permitted.
preregistration.p_hacking_guard: Exactly two logical candidates are registered: the fixed three-class Random Forest model at 1h and at 4h decision cadence. Four walk-forward folds, three target outcomes, and two cost scenarios are evaluation/reporting dimensions, not extra candidate variants.

hypothesis.statement: A three-class first-touch target that distinguishes take-profit-first, stop-loss-first, and vertical-timeout outcomes may be more decision-useful than the previously tested binary first-touch target. A single regularized RandomForestClassifier can identify a subset of Nobitex BTCUSDT decisions with sufficiently high TP_FIRST probability to produce positive post-cost economics under fixed execution assumptions.
hypothesis.null_hypothesis: The fixed RandomForestClassifier does not generate at least 100 completed OOS long trades with NetPF >= 1.10, MaxDD <= 15%, and stable profitable outcomes in at least three of four chronological folds at both registered costs for both decision cadences.
hypothesis.related_prior_trial: ADR-056 REGIME-T-TB-LOGISTIC-01 is a related but distinct prior experiment: binary upper-first versus lower-first labels, 2x ATR barriers, 24-hour vertical horizon, three folds, and pooled OOF accuracy screen. Its NO-GO result is retained as prior related trial evidence and is not overwritten or pooled as an M6 candidate.
hypothesis.claim_type: Prospective exploratory PRE-HACK research hypothesis; not empirically tested by this registration.
hypothesis.model_rationale: Random Forest supports nonlinear interactions and multiclass probabilities. It is not intrinsically immune to overfitting; fixed shallow depth, minimum leaf/split sizes, a single frozen configuration, chronological folds, and no hyperparameter search are mandatory controls.

scope.target_market_source: Existing committed Nobitex public Spot BTCUSDT PRE-HACK 1h OHLCV CSV only.
excluded_sources: OFI, MLOFI, order-book, trades, tick or other microstructure data
on-chain data and paid vendor APIs
other exchanges or aggregated market prices
synthetic CI fixtures as empirical observations

data_binding.required_before_fit: All three byte-level SHA-256 commitments and the manifest/data-lock scope fields must match exactly. Any mismatch fails closed before feature construction or fitting.

four_hour_construction.input: The exact hash-verified 1h BTCUSDT candles above.
four_hour_construction.aggregation: Group four consecutive hourly candles from the first committed PRE-HACK timestamp, using non-overlapping fixed groups. 4h open is first open, high is maximum high, low is minimum low, close is final close, and volume is the sum of four hourly volumes.
four_hour_construction.anchor: UTC fixed anchor at the first source candle start (2021-10-31T20:30:00Z); no calendar rebucketing or external 4h source.
four_hour_construction.incomplete_group_policy: Drop and report any trailing group with fewer than four hourly rows. Do not interpolate, fill or splice.
four_hour_construction.bar_index_mapping: Every 4h bar records the base-hour indices of its first and fourth constituent hourly candles. Entry for a 4h decision is the open of the first hourly candle in the next complete 4h group.

features.time_unit: One bar in the selected decision timeframe: 1 hour for the 1h candidate and 4 hours for the 4h candidate.

definitions.log_return_1: ln(close[t] / close[t-1]) on completed bars of the selected decision timeframe.
definitions.log_return_4: ln(close[t] / close[t-4]) on completed bars of the selected decision timeframe.
definitions.log_return_24: ln(close[t] / close[t-24]) on completed bars of the selected decision timeframe.
definitions.realized_volatility_6: Population standard deviation (ddof=0) of the six most recent selected-timeframe log_return_1 observations, including the return ending at t.
definitions.realized_volatility_24: Population standard deviation (ddof=0) of the 24 most recent selected-timeframe log_return_1 observations, including the return ending at t.
definitions.range_fraction_1: (high[t] - low[t]) / close[t] for the completed selected-timeframe candle.
definitions.atr_fraction_14: Wilder ATR(14) / close[t]. TrueRange[t] = max(high-low, abs(high-prev_close), abs(low-prev_close)); the first row uses high-low. Seed with the arithmetic mean of the first 14 valid TrueRange values, then ATR[t] = (13*ATR[t-1] + TrueRange[t])/14.
definitions.log_volume_change_1: ln(1 + selected-timeframe base-asset volume[t]) - ln(1 + selected-timeframe base-asset volume[t-1]); 4h volume is the sum of the four constituent hourly volumes.

features.availability: Features are calculated only after the selected-timeframe bar is fully complete. Rolling windows are right-aligned and use data through t only. No centered windows, backfill, interpolation, partial warm-up, label-derived feature, sentiment, time-of-day, order-book or trade-flow field is permitted.
features.missing_value_policy: No imputation or fill. Drop and count rows with insufficient warm-up, non-finite features, invalid OHLCV, or invalid ATR.
features.feature_selection_policy: Exactly these eight columns, in this order. No feature selection, PCA, interaction expansion, extra lag, alternate indicator or ablation is allowed.

target.decision_timing: Decision after the close of a fully completed 1h or 4h candle t. All features are available by this close.
target.entry: Open of the next complete candle in the selected decision timeframe. For 4h decisions, this is the open of the first hourly candle in the next complete four-hour group.
target.volatility_scale: atr_fraction_14 computed on the selected decision timeframe at t; fixed before inspecting any future candle.

barriers.invalid_stop_rule: If the calculated stop price is not strictly positive, mark the event unavailable and exclude it.

vertical_barrier.observation_window: The 24 underlying hourly candles beginning with the entry candle, including entry hour through the 24th hourly candle.
vertical_barrier.four_hour_candidate: Inspect the 24 underlying 1h candles corresponding to six complete future 4h periods; event resolution still uses the original 1h OHLCV bars.
vertical_barrier.expiry: If neither horizontal barrier is touched during the 24-hour observation window, label VERTICAL_TIMEOUT and exit at the close of the 24th hourly candle.

event_resolution.first_touch: The earliest underlying hourly candle that touches a horizontal barrier determines the outcome.
event_resolution.opening_gap: After the entry candle, if a future hourly candle opens at or above TP, resolve TP_FIRST at that candle open; if it opens at or below SL, resolve SL_FIRST at that candle open. This gives favorable TP gaps the open price and adverse SL gaps the worse open price.
event_resolution.same_hour_dual_touch: If the same hourly OHLC candle has high >= TP and low <= SL and its open did not already resolve a gap, mark AMBIGUOUS. It is not a fourth class and is excluded from classifier fitting and classification metrics.
event_resolution.ambiguous_economic_policy: If an OOS prediction triggered a long trade whose event is AMBIGUOUS, resolve its economic ledger conservatively at the stop-loss price and count the completed trade. Never choose the favorable intrabar ordering.
event_resolution.timeout: VERTICAL_TIMEOUT is a genuine third supervised class and is retained in fit, prediction, and evaluation.
event_resolution.unavailable: Rows with an incomplete 24-hour future window, invalid features/ATR, or an invalid stop price are unavailable and are excluded from model fit and OOS economic signals.

target.label_end_for_purging: Conservatively use the maximum possible 24-hour event end even if a horizontal barrier is touched earlier. Training label end must be strictly earlier than the first test entry boundary minus the registered 24-hour embargo.

model.fit_policy: Exactly one fixed RandomForestClassifier fit per horizon and eligible fold. No scaler, model ensemble, class oversampling, probability calibration, class threshold optimization, hyperparameter search, tuning, or candidate variant.
model.probability_policy: Use the uncalibrated RandomForest predict_proba output as a fixed screening score. No calibration or threshold sweep is allowed. Report class-wise probabilities and class counts.

signal.comparison: strictly greater than 0.60; equality does not enter
signal.entry_rule: Open a long-only research cohort at the next selected-timeframe candle open only when P(TP_FIRST) > 0.60.
signal.no_trade_policy: If P(TP_FIRST) <= 0.60, hold cash. No short signal is generated from SL_FIRST.

walk_forward.block_construction: Sort feature-eligible UTC decision timestamps independently for 1h and 4h. Split into five contiguous chronological blocks using deterministic boundaries floor(k*N/5), k=1..4. B1 is initial training history; B2..B5 are successive test blocks.

training_rules.purge_rule: For each fold, exclude any training event whose maximum 24-hour event window reaches or overlaps the first test entry boundary.
training_rules.embargo_rule: In addition to purging, require maximum event end < first test entry base-hour index - 24 hours. This fixed 24-hour embargo is applied before the test block for both decision cadences.
training_rules.test_rows: Include only decisions whose full maximum 24-hour event window ends within the same test block. AMBIGUOUS events may be predicted and enter the economic ledger only under the conservative SL rule; they are excluded from supervised metrics.

walk_forward.insufficient_data_rule: If any fold lacks 200 mature training rows or 20 rows from each of the three classes, record INSUFFICIENT_SAMPLE and do not fit that fold. Do not alter folds, relax class minimums, shorten the event horizon, or add data. All four folds must be reported.

economic_evaluation.entry_price: Next selected-timeframe candle open; for 4h, the first constituent hourly open.
economic_evaluation.exit_price: First TP or SL barrier fill under the frozen gap policy, otherwise close of the 24th future hourly candle; ambiguous dual-touch OOS events are charged at SL.
economic_evaluation.cost_interpretation: Apply one all-in round-trip friction charge per completed cohort. Subtract the complete cost once from each trade return; do not add a second spread/slippage charge.
economic_evaluation.position_sizing: Fixed notional as a fraction of initial equity per signal: 1/25 for the 1h candidate and 1/7 for the 4h candidate. These include one conservative boundary-overlap slot beyond the maximum 24h concurrency (24 hourly entries or six 4h entries). No leverage, compounding or NAV-based resizing. Maximum planned gross exposure is <=1.0x initial equity.
economic_evaluation.mark_to_market: Mark open positions at each underlying hourly close. Charge the full round-trip cost from entry for conservative NAV marking. Realize the actual barrier/gap/timeout exit price on the event hour. MaxDD is chronological peak-to-trough NAV drawdown across hourly marks.
economic_evaluation.completed_trade_definition: One long signal with a fully observed 24-hour event window that is closed by TP, SL, or vertical timeout inside its own OOS test block. AMBIGUOUS signal trades count and are conservatively resolved at SL.
economic_evaluation.net_profit_factor_formula: Sum of positive net trade PnL divided by the absolute sum of negative net trade PnL. Undefined when there are no negative net trades and therefore does not pass automatically.

acceptance_gates.fold_validity_rule: A valid fold has at least 20 completed costed OOS trades.
acceptance_gates.fold_stability_rule: At least 3 of 4 chronological test folds must each contain at least 20 completed OOS trades, positive net PnL, and fold NetPF > 1.00.
acceptance_gates.pooled_rule: For each horizon under each cost scenario, pooled OOS NetPF >= 1.10, completed costed OOS trades >= 100, MaxDD <= 15%, at least 3 valid folds, and at least 3 stable folds are all mandatory.
acceptance_gates.overall_pass_rule: Both the 1h and 4h candidates must independently pass all five gates at both Cost-50 and Cost-90. No metric or fold can be hidden or substituted.
acceptance_gates.global_trial_accounting: GLOBAL_N=UNKNOWN remains unchanged. ADR-056 is a related prior Triple-Barrier experiment and must be disclosed in the result. Do not manufacture a global DSR.
acceptance_gates.dsr_status: GLOBAL_DSR=NOT_COMPUTABLE unless the complete historical candidate cohort and required return inputs are independently reconciled. Passing these exploratory economics gates does not itself create confirmatory statistical evidence or trading authority.
